42057-bill-biddon-trapper-or-life-in-the.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Before going further, I may as well introduce my friend and myself. My companion answered to the name of Nathan Todd, and was a native of Maine. He was a tall, lank individual, with long, attentuated limbs and an awkward appearance generally. He was very meager and muscular, and when roused to a heat of passion, as quick and powerful as the panther.

arxiv-2301-08680.title: Online Dependent Rounding Schemes for Bipartite Matchings, with Applications
arxiv-2301-08680.creator: Joseph (Seffi) Naor, Aravind Srinivasan, David Wajc
arxiv-2301-08680.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Joseph (Seffi) Naor, Aravind Srinivasan, David Wajc. We introduce the abstract problem of rounding an unknown fractional bipartite b b -matching 𝐱 \bf{x} revealed online (e.g., output by an online fractional algorithm), exposed node-by-node on one side. The objective is to maximize the rounding ratio of the output matching ℳ \mathcal{M} , which is the minimum over all fractional b b -matchings 𝐱 \bf{x} , and edges e e , of the ratio Pr [ e ∈ ℳ ] / x e \Pr[e\in\mathcal{M}]/x_{e} .

arxiv-2308-00317.title: A new class of nonparametric tests for second-order stochastic dominance based on the Lorenz P-P plot
arxiv-2308-00317.creator: Tommaso Lando, Sirio Legramanti
arxiv-2308-00317.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tommaso Lando, Sirio Legramanti. Given samples from two non-negative random variables, we propose a family of tests for the null hypothesis that one random variable stochastically dominates the other at the second order. Test statistics are obtained as functionals of the difference between the identity and the Lorenz P-P plot, defined as the composition between the inverse unscaled Lorenz curve of one distribution and the unscaled Lorenz curve of the other.

pmc-11295669.title: Investigating the relationship between aging perception and self-efficacy in the older adults: a cross-sectional study in Eastern Iran
pmc-11295669.creator: Mohsen Arjmand-sangani, Gholamreza Sharifzadeh, Narges Soltani, Marzieh Torshizi
pmc-11295669.description: BackgroundWith the global increase in the older adults population, understanding factors that impact their quality of life is crucial. The perception of aging and self-efficacy are significant factors affecting older adults health outcomes. This descriptive cross-sectional study investigates the relationship between Aging Perception and self-efficacyamong older adults individuals in Birjand city, a demographic that is rapidly increasing but under-research.

pmc-11496859.title: PD-L1 expression in testicular germ cell tumors undergoing spontaneous regression
pmc-11496859.creator: Ivan Novak, Miroslav Tomić, Denis Mulabdić, Ivan Pezelj, Slaven Čiček, Igor Tomašković, Nino Sinčić, Božo Krušlin, Monika Ulamec
pmc-11496859.description: Spontaneous regression of testicular germ cell tumors is a well-known phenomenon; however, the precise mechanisms of spontaneous regression are still unknown. Our study aimed to investigate programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression in spontaneously regressed testicular germ cell tumors, exploring the link between the immune response and spontaneous regression.

pmc-11631847.title: Role of lymphadenectomy in advanced-stage ovarian cancer: a meta-analysis
pmc-11631847.creator: Carlo Ronsini, Francesca Pasanisi, Giada Andreoli, Pasquale De Franciscis, Luigi Cobellis, Giuseppe Vizzielli, Stefano Restaino, Paola Romeo, Vittorio Palmara, Stefano Cianci
pmc-11631847.description: BackgroundEpithelial Ovarian Cancer is one of the most lethal cancers among gynecologic malignancies. The disease metastasizes mainly through the peritoneal spread in the abdomen and through the lymphatic system. Lymph node involvement is present in 48% up to 75% of cases of advanced-stage ovarian cancer (ASOC).

pmc-11795932.title: Trustworthiness assessment as an inclusion criterion for systematic reviews—What is the impact on results?
pmc-11795932.creator: Jo Weeks, Anna Cuthbert, Zarko Alfirevic
pmc-11795932.description: BackgroundThere is increasing concern that a significant proportion of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) included in Cochrane reviews may not be trustworthy. Applying the Cochrane Pregnancy and Childbirth Trustworthiness Screening Tool (CPC‐TST) has already had a clinically important effect on several reviews published by the Cochrane Pregnancy and Childbirth Group.

pmc-12695965.title: Lidar reveals distinct insect daily activity and diversity between habitats
pmc-12695965.creator: Assoumou S Doria Yamoa, Benoit K Kouakou, Adolphe Y Gbogbo, Anna Runemark, Roel van Klink, Jeremie T Zoueu, Mikkel Brydegaard
pmc-12695965.description: Entomological lidar can provide rapid, non-intrusive assessment of insect abundance, diversity and composition, and has the potential to shed light on species specific preferences for habitats or environmental conditions. However, few studies have to date demonstrated comparisons of insect diversity and abundance across sites using photonic methods.

pmc-13301607.title: Inositol 1,4,5-triphosphate receptor (IP3R)-mediated calcium release: a compensatory mechanism in calcium release channel deficiency syndrome
pmc-13301607.creator: L Giammarino, D J Tester, S Dasari, D Ye, J R Giudicessi, J Kim, M J Ackerman
pmc-13301607.description: BackgroundCalcium release channel deficiency syndrome (CRCDS) arises from loss-of-function variants in the RYR2-encoded type 2 ryanodine receptor (RyR2), predisposing patients to sudden cardiac arrest/death (SCA/SCD) despite normal exercise testing. Previously, a novel homozygous RYR2 duplication causing ~ 80% RyR2 reduction was associated with exertion-related SCD. However, how Ca2+ homeostasis is maintained despite RyR2-loss remains unknown, as RYR2-/- animals are non-viable.

pmc-13338632.title: Current Landscape and Future Perspectives of Diabetic Retinopathy Therapy: Pharmacological Targets, Precision Laser Technology, and Clinical Evidence
pmc-13338632.creator: Xinying Hu, Zhe Cha, Ao Lu, Wuping Xu, Xiaoqing Zhang, Sheng Miao, Haiwei Xu, Xuedong Xu
pmc-13338632.description: Diabetic retinopathy (DR), a major cause of blindness worldwide, poses a substantial and escalating burden on public health. The limitations of current therapeutic modalities highlight the pressing need for continued innovation in therapeutic interventions. This review comprehensively delineated the knowledge architecture, research focal points, and emerging directions in DR therapeutics.

pmc-13354506.title: Knowledge and Attitudes Toward Strep Throat and Rheumatic Fever: A Cross-Sectional Study Among the United Arab Emirates Population
pmc-13354506.creator: Ahmad Hisham Al-Anoud, Mawiah Zhour Adi, Bayan Bozalasal, Saryia Adra, Kifaya Tamimi, Laila Nour Aldeen Ismail, Hiba Jawdat Barqawi
pmc-13354506.description: BackgroundGroup A Streptococcus pharyngitis, or strep throat, can lead to rheumatic fever (RF) and rheumatic heart disease (RHD) if left untreated. While these conditions are a public health concern, limited evidence exists on public awareness in the United Arab Emirates (UAE). This study assessed the knowledge and attitudes toward strep throat and RF among UAE residents.

pmc-13461352.title: The paradox of miR-107 in oncology: dual roles as a tumor suppressor and oncomiR
pmc-13461352.creator: Mamdouh A. Ragab, Nevine Fathy, Yasmin M. Attia, Eman A. Amer, Sally A. Fahim
pmc-13461352.description: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are central post-transcriptional regulators that shape oncogenic and tumor-suppressive networks through RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC)–mediated repression of target mRNAs. Among these, hsa-miR-107—a member of the miR-16 family encoded within an intron of the PANK1 gene—has emerged as a particularly paradoxical regulator in cancer.

pmc-13596115.title: Platelet-Rich Plasma for Postherpetic Neuralgia: Proposed Mechanisms, Clinical Evidence, and Future Research Directions
pmc-13596115.creator: YuQi Wang, Hong Cao, Hong Cao
pmc-13596115.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This is a narrative review. A structured literature search was performed across major medical databases to identify relevant pre-clinical and clinical studies investigating PRP for PHN. In total, 10 clinical studies of varied designs were included in this review. Postherpetic neuralgia (PHN) is a refractory neuropathic pain condition characterized by persistent pain lasting more than three months after the resolution of acute herpes zoster.

pmc-13599594.title: Long‐Term Renal Function and Clinical Outcomes of Sacubitril/Valsartan in HFrEF and Stage 3–4 Chronic Kidney Disease: A 24‐Month Single‐Centre Cohort
pmc-13599594.creator: Fatih Akkaya, Onur Osman Şeker, Ercan Türkmen, Seçkin Dereli
pmc-13599594.description: BackgroundStage 3–4 chronic kidney disease (CKD) is common in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) but remains underrepresented in angiotensin receptor–neprilysin inhibitor (ARNI) trials, fostering reluctance to initiate sacubitril/valsartan (S/V).HypothesisWe hypothesized that, over 24 months, S/V would be associated with stable renal function and acceptable clinical outcomes; the study was designed to be descriptive rather than comparative.

uslaw-usc-t16-s541f.title: 16 U.S.C. § 541f — Withdrawal from location, entry and patent under mining laws; withdrawal from disposition under mineral leasing laws
uslaw-usc-t16-s541f.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s541f.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 2 (National Forests); Subchapter II (Scenic Areas). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The lands within the Area, subject to valid existing rights, are hereby withdrawn from location, entry, and patent under the United States mining laws and from disposition under all laws pertaining to mineral leasing and all amendments thereto.
